Control description: The organization demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values
The board/management exercises oversight of internal control
Auditor expects: Defined roles and responsibilities; org chart
Evidence: Roles exist informally; to be documented

Control description: The organization commits to attract and retain competent people
The organization uses relevant information to support internal control
The organization communicates security responsibilities internally
The organization specifies objectives to identify and assess risk
The organization identifies and analyzes risks to its objectives
Auditor expects: Risk register with likelihood and impact

Control description: The organization evaluates whether controls are present and functioning
The organization develops control activities over technology
Logical access to systems is restricted through identification and authentication
Evidence: Project 10 - MFA and conditional access (Entra ID)

Control description: New access is authorized before being granted; access is removed on termination
Evidence: Access process exists; offboarding records missing

Control description: Access is granted based on least privilege and reviewed periodically
Evidence: Projects 1/2/10 - least privilege and access review (PIM)

Control description: The system protects against unauthorized external access
Auditor expects: Network controls; firewall and endpoint protection
Evidence: Project 1 - network and Defender; Project 3 - app testing

Control description: Credentials and keys are managed securely
Auditor expects: Secrets stored in a vault; rotation policy
Evidence: Project 2 - Key Vault managed identity and rotation

Control description: Unauthorized or malicious software is prevented or detected
Vulnerabilities are detected and monitored
Security events are monitored and anomalies detected
Evidence: Project 1 - logs and Defender exist; no SIEM/alerts

Control description: Security incidents are evaluated and responded to
Incidents are contained remediated and communicated
Changes to infrastructure and software are authorized tested and approved
Auditor expects: CI/CD pipeline; code review and approval records
Evidence: Project 2 - CI/CD with code review OIDC secret scanning

Control description: The organization identifies and manages risks from business disruption
Auditor expects: Backup and recovery plan; RTO/RPO defined

Control description: The organization assesses and manages vendor and partner risks
